name: Sales call prep assistant
why: Builds a one-page call plan from past notes and a follow-up draft after the call, the same flow as the discovery call plan prompt.

name: Sales call question planner
why: Plans problem, cost and value questions for a call, a quick way to fill the question bank in a play card.

name: Objection answer sheet writer
why: Turns buyers' doubts into honest answers with a question back, ready for the objections section of a playbook.

name: Monthly lost deal reviewer
why: Reviews lost deals each month for the real reasons, feeding the quarterly playbook and battlecard refresh.

name: Rival gap message writer
why: Writes messages from proven strengths against a rival's public weak spots, with evidence, matching the honest battlecard rules.

name: Rival weakness message finder
why: Finds a rival's weak spot that matches a real strength and that buyers can check, useful for the 'where we win' section.

name: Recall quiz writer
why: Turns lesson notes into recall quizzes with a repeat plan, the quizzing step in the 30-day onboarding plan.

name: Sales agent training planner
why: Plans a short course for people who will sell a product, a lighter start for the onboarding and certification skill.

name: Turn a recorded call into notes, a follow-up and coaching
why: Turns a consented call recording into notes, a follow-up and coaching points, a companion to the call coaching skill.

name: Negotiation call prep planner
why: Plans a hard negotiation call with an opening, questions and facts to learn first, alongside the negotiation plan prompt.

name: Negotiate from the weaker side and still get fair terms
why: A full play for negotiating with a bigger buyer or supplier, for teams that sell into large accounts.

name: Audit-to-sales presentation planner
why: Turns findings about a prospect into a ten-slide pitch with proof and a clear ask, a worked example of the problem-first deck.

name: Evidence-based sales copy writer
why: Puts proof beside every claim in sales copy, the same evidence bar this kit sets for decks and sell sheets.
